description_en: Queries the list of role permissions
kebab_example: aliyun websitebuild query-rbac-role-permissions --biz-id WS20250731233102000001 --role-id 75b2f16f-35a5-4e90-949f-295ea14a4dc8 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --order-column gmtCreated --order-type BUY --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRbacRolePermissions

parameters.description_en:
The organization role ID, including predefined roles and custom roles:

- Organization administrator (predefined role): 111111111
- Permission management administrator (predefined role): 111111112
- Regular user (predefined role): 111111113
- Custom role: the role ID of the custom role
